root_cause.text: In the `smb2_open_file` function of the CIFS client, the response buffer allocated by a failed `SMB2_open` call is not released before the fallback retry logic executes when encountering an `-EACCES` error, leading to persistent memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `free_rsp_buf(err_buftype, err_iov.iov_base);` inside the error handling block for `-EACCES` errors, directly preceding the retry `SMB2_open` call, while the CVE description reports `cifs_small_rq` slab cache objects remaining on module unload.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a memory leak by ensuring the error response buffer is freed before retrying an SMB2 open operation after receiving -EACCES.
intent_record.what: Added a call to free_rsp_buf() to release the error response buffer (err_iov.iov_base) inside the -EACCES retry logic block.
intent_record.how: Prevents memory leakage of the response buffer generated during the initial failed SMB2 open attempt before clearing read attributes and retrying the request.
